---
import { getEntry } from "astro:content";

import RelatedWorkCard from "../components/notes/RelatedWorkCard.astro";
import FeaturedWorkCard from "../components/works/FeaturedWorkCard.astro";
import HomeWorkCard from "../components/works/HomeWorkCard.astro";
import WorkCard from "../components/works/WorkCard.astro";
import WorkGallery from "../components/works/WorkGallery.astro";
import Layout from "../layouts/Layout.astro";

const work = await getEntry("work", "image-warning-test");
if (!work) throw new Error("Image warning fixture missing");
---

<Layout title="画像警告のテスト">
  <main>
    <h1>画像警告のテスト</h1>
    <section aria-label="画像が1枚のギャラリー">
      <WorkGallery images={work.data.images.slice(2)} title="単一画像" />
    </section>
    <section aria-label="カードの表示">
      <WorkCard work={work} />
      <HomeWorkCard work={work} slideIndex={0} slideCount={1} />
      <FeaturedWorkCard
        work={work}
        variant="card"
        slideIndex={0}
        slideCount={1}
      />
      <FeaturedWorkCard
        work={work}
        variant="list"
        slideIndex={0}
        slideCount={1}
      />
      <RelatedWorkCard work={work} />
    </section>
  </main>
</Layout>
